content.short: Alephium Bridge enables unlimited, decentralized cross-chain transfer of tokens.
content.description: As the multichain landscape grows, secure and efficient cross-chain transfers become essential for ecosystems spanning multiple networks. Alephium's core contributors have built a battle-tested bridge to establish the primary cross-chain link with Ethereum, with the potential to connect additional chains in the future. The Alephium Bridge blends several interoperable components into a cohesive system that enables reliable, high-performance cross-chain communication across supported networks.
